title: Easier to find the journey planner
summary: Plan journey is now a labelled button on the map, and you can start a journey from the Here sheet or the Downtime screen.
items: A labelled Plan journey button sits under Here on the map on phones, tablets and desktops, and stays when the tool bar is collapsed.
The Here sheet has Plan a journey at the party's location, and Journey progress while the party is on the road.
The Downtime screen starts with Travel: the party's journey, Plan a journey on the map, and journey requests.
On phones the map zooms out to show above the planner, and the journey review opens full height.
Journey progress shows a bar with a mark where each leg ends; players on a private map see their text-only journey card on Maps.
Undo removes the last waypoint, and optional journey costs show what they would cost before you turn them on.
